name: [HUGE UPD] Flag Football 🏈
desc:
🏈 Flag Football

Step onto the field and experience fast-paced flag football like never before! The game is currently in early beta, so bugs and glitches are to be expected, but the core gameplay is ready for you to enjoy and compete in.

👍 Leave a like and favorite to support development and future updates!
⚡ Join the College Football Group to participate in league games and organized events.
❌ Report any bugs, glitches, or feedback in our Social Server — your input helps shape the game!
